title: Header generated from the reconciliation log
goal: A layout segment {"header": "docs/archive"} renders 'Current work ledger, reviewed <date> against <branch> `<sha>`. <summary>' from the newest `## <date> — main `<sha>`` entry; the authored line goes away
acceptance: work-items renders the header segment from the newest entry (date, then git ancestry when two entries share a day), first paragraph at most 300 characters, and refuses a malformed entry
check-freshness still finds the sha; older bullet-style log lines are ignored, never changed
Both BACKLOG-RULES copies describe the entry format; tests
privacy: Tool and rule text only; fixtures invented.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Judged 2026-11-12 from F-059's layout work: one segment type, one parser, tests. Estimate, not a measurement. Implemented 2026-11-12, actual so far stated.
